stories.title: How the last U.S.-China talks on AI could inform this week's summit
stories.summary: NPR's Juana Summers speaks with Seth Center, a former U.S. diplomat who has previously negotiated with China regarding AI concerns, about his doubts around this week's China-U.S. summit.

stories.title: Alaska's annual Fat Bear Week kicks off
stories.summary: Bears in Katmai National Park and Preserve in Alaska have been bulking up on salmon before winter. On Tuesday, annual voting kicks off for the favorite.

stories.title: Explaining Trump TV — and how it could help or hurt President Trump
stories.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow talks with media consultant and television producer Mark McKinnon about the launching of Trump TV, an official White House Youtube channel, streaming 24/7.

stories.title: Indian American comic explores her Kentucky roots
stories.summary: In her new show, comedian Pooja Reddy busts stereotypes as her youth in rural Kentucky takes center stage.

stories.title: Questions remain after grand jury declines indictment in Nolan Wells' death
stories.summary: The Black Mississippi teen's family questions whether his race contributed to his July 4th death on an island off the Mississippi coast.

stories.title: RFK Jr.'s ethics disclosure reveals free travel and hefty book advances
stories.summary: Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s latest financial disclosure reveals he accepted free flights to Fiji and Greece and lucrative book advances.
